name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd

ledger.quote: Hopefully, we should be able to file the product before the end of this calendar year.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.target: file Ilumya PsA before end of calendar year
ledger.verdict: Management did not mention filing Ilumya PsA before the end of CY2025 on the call.

ledger.quote: We are planning to launch UNLOXCYT in the US in the second half of FY'26.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.target: launch UNLOXCYT in US in second half of FY26

ledger.evidence: Unloxcyt was launched earlier this year. ledger.quote: If we plan, we will see some impact this year, this fiscal year.
ledger.speaker: Richard Ascroft
ledger.target: revenue impact from Leqselvi this fiscal year
ledger.verdict: Leqselvi launched with prescriptions growing monthly and surpassing 1,000 prescribers by June.
ledger.evidence: We're seeing good momentum in Leqselvi with prescriptions and the number of prescribers expanding each month. In the month of June, we surpassed 1,000 prescribers, and we also delivered our strongest month since launch, demonstrating increased adoption and growing confidence in the brand.

ledger.quote: For the full year, we can consider around 25%.

ledger.target: tax rate around 25% for full year
ledger.verdict: Full year FY26 tax rate came in at 23.9% on PBT of Rs 15,119 crore and PAT of Rs 11,509 crore.
ledger.evidence: PBT total for FY26 was Rs 15119 crore and PAT was Rs 11509 crore, implying a 23.9% effective tax rate.

ledger.quote: We expect to launch in the second half of the fiscal year.

ledger.target: launch in second half of fiscal year

ledger.quote: So, we currently have three facilities that are under warning letter from the US FDA. Mohali, Dadra, and Halol.
ledger.speaker: Aalok Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: Resolution of FDA warning letters for Mohali, Dadra, and Halol facilities remains pending.

ledger.quote: So Neha, I think we should come in the lower end of the guidance overall, that's what is our assessment today.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: Management did not report final full year FY26 R&D spend relative to guidance on the call.

ledger.quote: We are publishing phase-2a data in the certain scientific conferences, both for diabetes as well as for NASH over the next few months.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.target: Publish phase-2a data in scientific conferences
ledger.verdict: Management did not provide updates on publishing phase-2a diabetes and NASH data on the call.

ledger.quote: But the current phase-2b study which has started, that should possibly get over within maybe 12-to-18 months.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: Phase-2b study timeframe of 12 to 18 months remains ongoing.

ledger.quote: On the guidance, we expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.target: high single-digit consolidated top line growth
ledger.verdict: FY27 full-year top-line guidance remains pending with Q1 revenue growing 10.1% to Rs 15,183.6 crore.

ledger.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: FY27 R&D spend target of 6% to 7% of sales is ongoing, with Q1 spend at 5.4%.

ledger.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: Organon acquisition remains on track for completion in Q4 FY27 following shareholder approval.

ledger.quote: Yes. We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.
ledger.speaker: Jayashree Satagopan
ledger.verdict: FY27 effective tax rate guidance is ongoing, with Q1 FY27 coming in at 27.8%.

open.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 of financial year '27 and an integration management office has been working on day one preparedness.
open.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi

open.quote: Going forward, and until Organon closing, we expect the tax rate to be in a similar range as in Q1.
open.speaker: Jayashree Satagopan

read: Management has delivered on key US commercial product launches such as Unloxcyt and Leqselvi alongside achieving FY26 tax targets. However, disclosures were omitted regarding regulatory filings for ILUMYA PsA and full-year FY26 R&D spend outcomes.
questions: Has the ILUMYA psoriatic arthritis sBLA been filed as planned in H2 FY26?
Did full year FY26 R&D expenditure finish at the lower end of guidance?
When will the phase-2a data for diabetes and NASH be published in scientific conferences?
bull: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales reached Rs 15,183.6 crore, growing 10.1% year-on-year.
US commercial launches of Unloxcyt and Leqselvi were successfully delivered as committed.
Full year FY26 effective tax rate was maintained near guidance at 23.9%.
bear: Status of ILUMYA psoriatic arthritis sBLA filing was not disclosed on the latest call.
Resolution of FDA warning letters for Mohali, Dadra, and Halol facilities remains pending.
Q1 FY27 effective tax rate increased to 27.8% from 24.3% in Q1 FY26.
